# agentz authoring conventions

The conventions live in the `contributor-conventions` skill of the `onboarding` plugin, so every client reads the same copy: `plugins/onboarding/skills/contributor-conventions/references/authoring.md`. Read and follow it before creating or changing a skill, agent, command or manifest under `plugins/`.
